summary.zh: 把最关键的准备步骤放进首回合，换取开局的稳定性。
summary.en: Guarantee an essential setup card at the start of a fight.

rules.zh: 给少量牌附加开局保证，使它们必定出现在首手或专门的开局阶段。玩家在战前选择先保证哪个环节，同时承担占用首手位置、金币或稀缺标记的成本。
rules.en: Give a few cards guaranteed access in the opening hand or a special opening phase. Before battle, choose which setup step deserves certainty and pay with a hand slot, money or a scarce marker.

decisions.zh: 保证防守能降低翻车风险，保证引擎牌能更快滚起优势，先选哪一个？
decisions.en: Guarantee safety or guarantee the engine that builds an advantage?

decisions.zh: 首手全是准备牌时，是否还留得下立即应对敌人的牌？
decisions.en: Will a setup-heavy opening still contain immediate answers?

effect.zh: 数量过多会让每场开局变成固定脚本。
effect.en: Too many guaranteed cards turn openings into a fixed script.

effect.zh: 只保证抽到与额外免费打出，会产生很不同的强度。
effect.en: Guaranteed drawing is much weaker than guaranteed free deployment.

contrast.zh: Innate 主要解决抽不到的问题；皇冠还改变行动时机，允许先完成部署。
contrast.en: Innate primarily fixes access; crowns also change timing by allowing deployment before normal turns.

combination.zh: 设计提案：允许玩家指定一张自动装置卡开局出现，再用条件控制决定它何时启动。
combination.en: Design proposal: Guarantee one automation card at setup, then let conditions govern when it activates.

setup.zh: 编辑示例：八张牌里有一张发电机，其他机器需要它供电。
setup.en: Editorial example: an eight-card deck contains one generator required by other machines.

action.zh: 玩家把唯一的开局标记给发电机。
action.en: Assign the only opening marker to the generator.

result.zh: 第一回合必定能先建发电机，但少抽一张随机牌。
result.en: The generator is available on turn one, replacing one random draw.

next.zh: 后续再按抽到的机器决定生产方向。
next.en: Choose the production plan from subsequent machine draws.

firstStep.zh: 做八张牌和一个可移动的开局标记，让玩家连续试三次开局。
firstStep.en: Use eight cards and one movable opening marker across three test openings.

pitfall.zh: 首版不要同时支持免费打出、额外抽牌和任意排序，以免分不清稳定性的价值。
pitfall.en: Avoid adding free play, bonus draws and full ordering at once.

test.zh: 玩家能察觉开局更可靠，也能指出为它牺牲了哪个首手选项。
test.en: Players notice greater reliability and identify the opening option it displaced.
